description: Work in the user's Dataiku DSS instance, as Dataiku Headless does: inspect projects, datasets (schema, size, sample rows), recipes, scenarios and jobs; build a dataset or run a scenario and follow the job; and delegate building or changing a project's assets (recipes, flows, models, dashboards, agents, wikis) to Cobuild, Dataiku's own agent. Inspect first (list_projects, project, dataset) and use real project keys and dataset names. To create or change anything inside a project, use action cobuild with a plain-language instruction rather than describing the steps yourself; set allow_edit=true only when the user asked for the change, and verify the result afterwards with project or dataset. Cobuild keeps its conversation in DSS: pass the returned conversation_id to continue it. When a result has a confirmation_id, Cobuild wants to delete something: show the user exactly what (objects_to_delete, deletion_impacts) and ask them before calling cobuild_confirm with APPROVE; otherwise CANCEL. When it has a question_id, answer it with cobuild_answer (ask the user if the answer is theirs to give). build and run_scenario wait up to four minutes; if the result says it is still running, check later with job or scenario. dataset with export=true writes the rows as CSV to dataiku/<PROJECT>/<dataset>.csv in the workspace, for run_python. Give the user the url from the result so they can open the object in Dataiku.
author: Hannes Hapke

action.description: instance: the connected instance and user. list_projects: the projects (filter with query). project: a project's datasets, recipes, scenarios and variables. dataset: a dataset's schema, size and sample rows. build: build a dataset. job: a job's state (log=true for its log). run_scenario: run a scenario. scenario: a scenario's last runs. cobuild: send Cobuild a message (starts a conversation unless conversation_id is given). cobuild_confirm / cobuild_answer: answer Cobuild's pending confirmation or question.

project_key.description: The project key, e.g. SALES_FORECAST. Required by every action but instance and list_projects.

query.description: list_projects: keep the projects whose key or name contains this.

limit.description: dataset: sample rows to return (default 20, 0 for none). list_projects: projects to list (default 50). scenario: runs to list (default 5).

export.description: dataset: also write the rows as CSV to dataiku/<PROJECT>/<dataset>.csv in the workspace.

export_limit.description: dataset with export: the most rows to write.

partitions.description: dataset, build: partition id(s), comma-separated, for a partitioned dataset.

mode.description: build: forced rebuilds just this dataset; recursive also builds what is out of date upstream; recursive_forced rebuilds everything upstream.

wait.description: build, run_scenario: wait (up to four minutes) for the result.

job_id.description: job: the job id that build returned.

log.description: job: include the end of the job's log.

params.description: run_scenario: parameters passed to the scenario run.

message.description: cobuild: what Cobuild should inspect, build or change, in plain language.

conversation_id.description: cobuild (to continue), cobuild_confirm, cobuild_answer: the conversation_id an earlier result returned.

allow_edit.description: cobuild: allow Cobuild to create and edit objects in the project for this message. False only inspects.

confirmation_id.description: cobuild_confirm: the confirmation_id from the result.

choice.description: cobuild_confirm: APPROVE only after the user agreed.

question_id.description: cobuild_answer: the question_id from the result.

answers.description: cobuild_answer: the chosen answers (from question.answers, or your own if custom_answer_allowed).

custom_answer.description: cobuild_answer: an answer is free text rather than one of question.answers.

reject.description: cobuild_answer: decline to answer and let Cobuild go on.

secrets.name: DKU_DSS_URL
secrets.description: The address of your Dataiku instance, e.g. https://dss-1a2b3c4d-5e6f7a8b-dku.eu-west-3.app.dataiku.io

secrets.name: DKU_API_KEY
secrets.description: A personal API key of your Dataiku account (Profile → API keys)

secrets.name: DKU_READ_ONLY
secrets.description: true to only inspect: no builds, scenario runs or Cobuild changes
